experiments.name: dependent vector chain with reset helper
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 100000 --iters 100 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4; li.d $r5, 1; li.d $r6, 4607182418800017408' --asm 'xvfrsqrt.d $xr0, $xr0; xvpickve2gr.d $r4, $xr0, 0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4'
experiments.notes: vpickve2gr extracts element 0, and/or forces it back to the test value, vreplgr2vr replicates it; the vadd.b baseline is subtracted.

experiments.name: vadd.b reset-helper baseline
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 100000 --iters 100 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4; li.d $r5, 1; li.d $r6, 4607182418800017408' --asm 'xvadd.b $xr0, $xr0, $xr0; xvpickve2gr.d $r4, $xr0, 0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4'
experiments.notes: Same helper chain with vadd.b replacing the variable-latency operation.

latencies.notes: Data-dependent. Latency range measured over 11 operand values with the element-0 reset helper. Min 10.97 at -1, max 55.00 at maxsub. Sample uses 1.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvfrsqrt.d $xr0, $xr8; xvfrsqrt.d $xr1, $xr9; xvfrsqrt.d $xr2, $xr10; xvfrsqrt.d $xr3, $xr11; xvfrsqrt.d $xr4, $xr12; xvfrsqrt.d $xr5, $xr13; xvfrsqrt.d $xr6, $xr14; xvfrsqrt.d $xr7, $xr15
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr15, $r4' --asm 'xvfrsqrt.d $xr0, $xr8; xvfrsqrt.d $xr1, $xr9; xvfrsqrt.d $xr2, $xr10; xvfrsqrt.d $xr3, $xr11; xvfrsqrt.d $xr4, $xr12; xvfrsqrt.d $xr5, $xr13; xvfrsqrt.d $xr6, $xr14; xvfrsqrt.d $xr7, $xr15'
throughput.notes: Throughput range over 11 operand values: min CPI 4.50 at 0, max CPI 26.50 at maxsub. Sample uses 1.

notes: LASX variable-latency floating-point instruction. Latency measured with a reset helper that keeps element 0 at the test value; throughput measured with 8 independent lanes. Ranges cover special values, exact/non-exact cases, subnormals, and overflow/underflow boundaries.
